errors.description: Typographical slip in the g=1 case: the write-up writes ℓ = m+n instead of ℓ = mn (lcm(m,n)/gcd = mn when gcd = 1). The subsequent sentence and the rest of the argument use the correct value mn, so nothing depends on it.
errors.quote:
Then $\ell = m+n \ge 2\cdot 2 = 4 > 1$, so the pair $(m,n)$ is replaced by
$(1, mn)$

parsed.notes: Termination via product/number-of-ones potential is correct and correctly bounded; 'no two 1's created' argument gives exactly one survivor; prime-wise gcd-of-valuations invariance (min, |α−β| preserves common divisors, zero case handled) yields the choice-independent formula. Computer checks are decorative, not load-bearing.
